title: John Hammond hears Turner and takes him to New York
summary: Hammond heard Turner, Rushing and Pete Johnson, took Basie east first, and later came back for Turner and Johnson.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: A couple weeks. Sometime they'd play...stay longer 'n' that. Count Basie and them was in there most of the time. And we had... A gentleman came there one time a long time ago, and, uh, John Hammonds. John Hammond a young man. He came through there, and he

heard me sing, he heard Jimmy Rushing sing. He used to go down to listen to Count Basie and listen to Jimmy Rushing. He'd come out there and listen to me and Pete Johnson, Ben Webster and all of us sing. So he said one of these days he gonna bring us to New York. 'Course, we didn't believe him, 'cause he was talent scout then, and he run around all over the country pickin' up entertainers, bringin' them to New York. So he did.

He took Count Basie's band first, and he wanted me to go with Count Basie's band and leave Jimmy Rushing but I wouldn't go because Jimmy Rushing had been working with Count Basie's band all along, and I was with Pete Johnson's band, so I tol' him I didn't want to go with Count Basie. I'll wait till he come back and he pick up my band.

So's Count Basie and them went to New York City. They stayed up there a long time, and, uh, finally, John Hammonds came back and got me and uh, Pete Johnson and took us to New York, and we uh...went to New York, and he recorded us. Then we met Meade Lux Lewis and Albert Ammons in Chica...in New York City.
